readings.Aries: You function best when there is something to push against. Right now, push gently. Sleep on it before committing.
readings.Taurus: Security is not something you find. It is something you construct, slowly, from trustworthy materials. Let this one be easy.
readings.Gemini: Something that feels like boredom is actually your mind signalling that you're underusing it. Trust the slow version of this over the fast one.
readings.Cancer: Home is not a place you go — it's a state you create. What would it take to feel it now? Go back to the original intention — it's still the right one.
readings.Leo: Someone who competed with you has moved on. You haven't. Notice this. Sleep on it before committing.
readings.Virgo: The research phase of this decision is complete. The decision phase requires something research can't provide. Notice what hasn't changed, not just what has.
readings.Libra: The decision is waiting for you. Not because more information is needed — because deciding feels like loss. The timing is better than it feels.
readings.Scorpio: Someone is being more honest with you than you're comfortable with. The discomfort is useful. The first instinct was right.
readings.Sagittarius: You learn more from discomfort than from comfort. You know this. Stay with this particular discomfort. Say the thing you've been rehearsing.
readings.Capricorn: You are further along than you think. The metric you're using is incorrect. The timing is better than it feels.
readings.Aquarius: Your version of intimacy is unusual and real. Someone is trying to understand it. Help them. The energy available today is better used gently.
readings.Pisces: Your empathy absorbs what others discard. Check what you've been holding that isn't yours. Simpler is correct here.

calculation_methods: Planetary longitudes: Jean Meeus 'Astronomical Algorithms' low-precision formulae (±1° accuracy)
Retrograde: computed from direction of longitude change vs previous day
Aspects: angular separation with standard orbs (conjunction 8°, sextile 6°, square/trine/opposition 8°, quincunx 3°)
Compatibility: element harmony base score + modality adjustment + date-seeded variance
Daily readings: deterministic date-seed (PRNG) selects from 60-entry per-sign pools + 30-entry suffix pool; 1,800 combinations per sign
